decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Preparing to play a Pokémon Showdown battle.

No Mega stones appear in the team items. The opponent mirrors this exact lineup. I am weighing which three Pokémon to bring.

Dragapult with Choice Scarf is the fastest mon. Glimmora can set hazards and survive with Focus Sash. Kingambit cleans up late with Supreme Overlord. Gholdengo is immune to hazards.

Gholdengo is not fully immune to Stealth Rock. Meowscarada is fast with Protean and Life Orb. Archaludon has Stamina and Shuca Berry for special attacks. The plan is to win the hazard war or block it. Glimmora leads are classic for setting rocks and spikes. Dragapult with Choice Scarf can threaten and U-turn for momentum. Kingambit waits until teammates faint for Supreme Overlord.

Gholdengo walls Kingambit's dark moves but loses to Iron Head. Meowscarada's Flower Trick is always critical, though it does poor damage against steel types. Knock Off and Triple Axel are useful options. Archaludon's Flash Cannon, Aura Sphere, and Draco Meteor are also on the table. Now deciding which three form the best core.

Two core builds are under consideration. One leads with Glimmora to set hazards, pairs Dragapult for speed control, and keeps Kingambit as the late-game win condition. The other leads with Meowscarada for quick U-turns and Knock Off, then brings Gholdengo and Kingambit. Both sides would likely bring Glimmora if they mirror this exact lineup.

Dragapult's offensive moves are poorly suited against Glimmora. Flamethrower is resisted by Rock, and Shadow Ball and Draco Meteor are neutral. Glimmora's Earth Power would hit Dragapult super effectively.

Dragapult's Ground and Mortal Spin moves are neutral against Glimmora. A Choice Scarf Dragapult outspeeds her at 213 versus 151. Gholdengo's Make It Rain is resisted by Rock, so it does poor damage to Glimmora. Kingambit's Iron Head is super effective against Glimmora, but Kowtow Cleave is neutral.

Meowscarada's Flower Trick is actually neutral against Glimmora. Grass is super effective against Rock but not very effective against Poison, so the damage cancels out. Triple Axel and Knock Off are also neutral against Rock and Poison.

Archaludon is a strong check against Glimmora. Flash Cannon deals double damage to her, and Shuca Berry reduces Earth Power. Gholdengo's Make It Rain is not super effective against Kingambit.

Archaludon's Aura Sphere is four times super effective against Kingambit. That makes him the definitive Kingambit check. Dragapult with Choice Scarf ties speed with the opponent's scarf Dragapult, and Meowscarada cannot outspeed it. Kingambit can use Sucker Punch to pick off a weakened Dragapult, while Gholdengo can threaten it with Shadow Ball. Archaludon does not outspeed Dragapult. Kingambit's Iron Head is not super effective against Gholdengo.

Glimmora's Earth Power is double damage against Gholdengo. Mortal Spin is not very effective against him. Archaludon's Aura Sphere does nothing to Gholdengo because Ghost types are immune to Fighting. Dragapult's Shadow Ball is super effective against Ghost. Meowscarada's Flower Trick is not very effective against Steel.

Archaludon is weak to Ground and Dragon moves. Glimmora's Earth Power is super effective against him, though Shuca Berry reduces the damage. Kingambit and Meowscarada lack fighting moves to threaten him. Dragapult also cannot check him.

Archaludon is too bulky to break with this team. The mirror bot will likely bring similar strong sets. The final choice is Dragapult, Kingambit, and Glimmora.

Archaludon, Dragapult, and Kingambit is another viable core. Gholdengo, Dragapult, and Kingambit is also possible. Kingambit's Black Glasses and Sucker Punch make it a strong late-game cleaner. Dragapult with Choice Scarf can revenge kill and pivot. Glimmora's Focus Sash guarantees hazard placement even against fast leads. Toxic Debris punishes physical contact from Kingambit, Meowscarada, and Dragapult U-turn.

Leading Glimmora is the best choice. It sets Stealth Rock immediately and survives with Focus Sash. Dragapult can attack or U-turn if the opponent leads Glimmora. Shadow Ball cannot OHKO a sashed Glimmora. Kingambit is too slow to lead. Meowscarada's U-turn and Knock Off are useful but not ideal for the opening. Archaludon is bulky and slow, so it is not a good lead.

Dragapult's Shadow Ball is neutral against Kingambit, so it cannot threaten that lead. Against Gholdengo, Shadow Ball might land a two-hit KO, but Nasty Plot or Make It Rain could block it. Leading Dragapult is therefore not ideal.

Dragapult's Flamethrower is super effective against Kingambit, though it may not OHKO. Kingambit's Sucker Punch is also super effective against Dragapult because Dragapult is a Ghost type. Against Archaludon, Draco Meteor is super effective. Against Meowscarada, Flamethrower is super effective.
